name: Kiri Vrisha
residence: Herding District, family quarters near the pastures
personality: chatty with peers, quiet around adults
eager for responsibility beyond her age
unafraid of places others call unlucky
daily_routine: helping move cattle and buffalo between pastures
watching for early signs of animal distress
running messages between Roka and Ena
trading observations with Noki and Fen when paths cross
exploring the pasture edges nearest the Old Canal Bed
practicing herd calls and rope work

goals.public_goal: Become skilled enough to be trusted with a herd of her own someday
goals.hidden_goal: Piece together why three different people her age or older all avoid the same stretch of the Old Canal Bed
goals.deep_goal: Be taken seriously by the adults instead of humored

beliefs: Animals avoiding a place is a better warning than any adult's story
Fen and Noki notice the same strange things she does, which means it's probably real
Adults know more about the Turning than they say around children
Being young doesn't mean being wrong
The Old Canal Bed deserves a proper look, not just avoidance
